outputs.discrepancies: The scatter plot x-axis labels the third condition as 'cmtR-pacL2G17L+G20L-ctpG' (glycine-to-leucine substitutions), but the corresponding disk-diffusion image to the right labels the same strain 'pacL2G17A+G20A' (glycine-to-alanine substitutions). This is inconsistent with the G17L+G20L mutant used and labeled consistently elsewhere in the figure (panels C-I), creating ambiguity about which mutation is actually shown in the disk assay image.

Caption states panel H shows 'cluster sizes,' but the image labeled H displays 'Mol.% into clusters' (proportion of molecules localized within a cluster), which is the quantity the caption assigns to panel I. Panels H and I appear swapped relative to the caption.

Caption states panel I shows 'the proportion of molecules localized within a cluster per cell,' but the image labeled I displays 'Clusters size (nm^3)' data, which is the quantity the caption assigns to panel H. Panels H and I appear swapped relative to the caption.
